title: onosma cinerea subsp. sanguinolenta
intro: Onosma cinerea subsp. sanguinolenta, commonly known as Balkan onosma, is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and cancer. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are mainly alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, including onosmone, onosmin, and sanguinolentin.
